title: Where the Gallows Stood
sentences: The exact spot of Salem’s hangings was only confirmed in 2016.
For centuries, many people assumed it was the top of Gallows Hill.
A team of scholars called the Gallows Hill Project spent six years on the question.
They used trial papers, eyewitness accounts and ground radar.
They concluded the hangings took place lower down, at a spot called Proctor’s Ledge.
In 2017, a memorial was dedicated there.
caption:
For 300 years, no one could say exactly where Salem's victims were hanged.
